command: Human WIPI2 (Q9Y4P8) participates in pexophagy, nucleophagy and glycophagy. Assess each separately, examining the actual PTN000132136 ancestral assignments, WIPI paralog divergence and primary mechanism. WIPI2 may contribute common phagophore/ATG16L1 adaptor machinery without being the selective cargo receptor; absence of cargo-recognition function does not exclude participation. Read GO definitions and parents: nucleophagy is not necessarily restricted to yeast piecemeal microautophagy of the nucleus. Distinguish general requirement or perturbation from a direct shared-machinery step in each selective pathway, and lack of a target-specific experiment from evidence of evolutionary loss.
